title: Record that revisit 1 forbids joint length-4 and length-6 returns.
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

A restored length-22 seven-label word of split `(11,10)` has exactly two extra prefix visits. None of the 231 closed position patterns contains both return distances 4 and 6. Explicit words attain `{2,20,22}` and `{4,18,22}`.

This does not decide `f(7)`, census universal words, or change κ. The selected frontier stays `836330098538459/500000000000000000`.

## Task and overlap

- Base: `bb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f`, priority revision 6.
- Task: `census-pruning-audit`, scope refined. The even-length existence cover is open PR #3730; this package only records the one-word gap at revisit 1.
- Not redone: the length-22 domain (#3708), the length-2 witnesses (#3726), the even-length existence cover (#3730), the parity note (#3719), and the universal census probes.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B research/revisit-one-return-gap/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/revisit-one-return-gap
```

Both passed on CPython 3.12.3. Expected marker:

```text
PASS_REVISIT_ONE_RETURN_GAP split=11,10 incompatible=4+6 patterns=231 no_new_kappa
```

No Lean, Docker, or selected cold replay was run.

## Credit

The revisit count and the positive splits come from the length-22 split-domain note. Lengths 2, 20 and 22, and the question for lengths 4 through 18, come from the later witness notes. The existence cover is open PR #3730. The one-bit parity fact is the preceding return note. The prefix-walk model is Ross Richardson's. The corrected parity census is Nicholas Stone's.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor agent assistance. No independent human review is claimed.

## Open next questions

Which pairs of even distances from 4 through 18 can share a restored word at revisit 2? The first step is to enumerate the three-extra-visit patterns and test the pair 4 and 6.
